description_en: Queries whether the routes of virtual private clouds (VPCs) and virtual border routers (VBRs) are advertised to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the VCPs and VBRs are attached, the instance type of the next hop of each route, and whether advertised routes can be withdrawn
description_zh: 您可以调用DescribePublishedRouteEntries接口查询已加载到CEN网络实例（VPC和VBR）的各条路由在CEN中的发布状态、路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型、是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网等信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-published-route-entries --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jm0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnv0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g40000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.0.0/16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePublishedRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例类型。取值： 

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

CCN：云连接网
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the network instance is deployed.

For more information, see [](t2264556.xdita#)
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

ChildInstanceRouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table of the network instance

Conflict.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目信息列表

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the conflicting route
DestinationCidrBlock.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目的目标网段

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the peer network instance with which the route conflicts
InstanceId.description_zh: 产生路由冲突的对端的网络实例ID

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the peer network instance with which the route conflicts.

VPC: a virtual private cloud.

VBR: a virtual border router.

CCN: a Cloud Connect Network instance
InstanceType.description_zh:
产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例类型。

VPC：专有网络。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the peer network instance with which the route conflicts is deployed
RegionId.description_zh: 产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例所属地域ID

Status.description_en:
The cause of the route conflict.

conflict: The route conflicts with another route that has the same destination CIDR block.

overflow: The number of routes in the route table of another network instance has reached its limit
Status.description_zh:
路由条目产生冲突的原因。

conflict：路由条目的目标网段相同造成的冲突。  
         
overflow：其他网络实例路由表的路由条目数量超出限制造成的冲突。

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

NextHopId.description_en: The ID of the instance associated with the next hop
NextHopId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的实例ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The type of the instance associated with the next hop.

Instance: an ECS instance.

HaVip: a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip).

RouterInterface: a router interface.

NetworkInterface: an elastic network interface (ENI).

VpnGateway: a VPN gateway.

IPv6Gateway: an IPv6 gateway.

Ipv4Gateway: an IPv4 gateway.

NatGateway: a NAT gateway.

Attachment: a network instance connection.

service: an Alibaba Cloud service.

VBR: a virtual border router.

CCN: a Cloud Connect Network instance.

VPC: a virtual private cloud.

local: The route is a system route of the network instance and has no next hop.

TR: a transit router.

BlackHole: The route is a blackhole route and has no next hop.

EcRouterInterface: an Express Connect router interface.

HealthCheck: a health check.

AS: an access gateway in a CCN instance.

classicLink: a classic network instance.

GatewayEndpoint: a gateway endpoint.

CPE: a data center connected to a VBR
NextHopType.description_zh:
路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型。

Instance：ECS实例。
HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。
RouterInterface：路由器接口。
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。
VpnGateway：VPN网关。
IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
NatGateway：NAT网关。
Attachment：网络实例连接。
service：云服务。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网。
VPC：专有网络。
local：表示当前路由条目为网络实例的系统路由，没有下一跳。
TR：转发路由器。
BlackHole：表示当前路由条目为黑洞路由，没有下一跳。
EcRouterInterface：高速通道路由器接口。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AS：云连接网接入网关。
classicLink：经典网络实例。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
CPE：边界路由器连接的本地数据中心

OperationalMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the route can be advertised to or withdrawn from the CEN instance.

true: The route can be advertised or withdrawn.

false: The route cannot be advertised or withdrawn
OperationalMode.description_zh:
是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网。

true：允许发布或撤销。

false：不允许发布或撤销

PublishStatus.description_en:
The advertise status of the route in the CEN instance:

Published: The route is advertised.

NonPublished: The route is not advertised
PublishStatus.description_zh:
在云企业网中的发布状态：

Published：已发布。

NonPublished：未发布

RouteType.description_en:
The type of the route.

CEN: a route learned from the CEN instance.

System: a system route.

Custom: a custom route
RouteType.description_zh:
路由条目的类型。

CEN：表示通过云企业网传递的路由。
System：表示系统路由。
Custom：表示自定义路由

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
